findings.detail: The extracted position sum omits $49.874 million of short-term investments included in the filing's total investments at fair value.
The extracted position sum nets the $9.492 million negative fair value of unfunded commitments against investments even though it is outside the filing's investment total.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows extracted fair value of $4,434.408 million versus the filing schedule total of $4,493.774 million, a $59.366 million shortfall. Raw source localizes the full residual: $49.874 million of short-term investments is omitted, and the $9.492 million negative fair value of unfunded commitments is improperly netted into the investment position sum. Their sum is exactly $59.366 million.
